answer: A farm therefore pays the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. The canyon debit happens at intake, meadow totals the burned amount, and falcon anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 7 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. Slashing removes 27 percent at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
